story_title: As an Event Coordinator, I want to postpone an event with no new date yet so arrangements aren't wasted while a date is pending.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an event has no confirmed new date, when the assigned Coordinator postpones it, then the event status changes to Postponed.
Only the assigned Event Coordinator can postpone the event; an Event Organiser asks for a postponement through Request Event Change or outside the system, and the Coordinator records it.
Postponing releases all of the event's existing venue bookings, at every venue, and its equipment arrangements, which become available for other events; the event record itself is retained.
A pending Operational Safety Check for the event is closed, and an existing safety approval no longer applies; the event must be submitted for a safety check again once new arrangements are made.
A reason for postponement can be recorded.
Providing a new date for a postponed event is handled as a rescheduling request through Request Event Change, with affected arrangements reviewed before new arrangements are made.

Given a rescheduling request for a postponed event is approved (see: Process Event Change Request, SPM-32), when the new date is saved, then the event moves from Postponed to Approved, and the Coordinator's next venue or equipment action begins planning again (see: Begin Event Planning, SPM-54).
A postponed event without a confirmed new date is not displayed as an upcoming event to Attendees.

open_questions: Written 2026-10-26 before any SPM-38 code (test-first, kayalvizhi24); built 2026-10-27 to the wording DECIDED below, and each case checked against the built screens. TC13 still quotes SPM-32's unmerged screen.

DECIDED 2026-10-26 (AC1, AC4, which stages, kayalvizhi24): an event can be postponed from Approved, Planning, Safety review, Safety approved and Confirmed - every stage after approval that is not final. Today canTransition() (src/lib/statuses.ts) allows Postponed from Planning and Confirmed only; Safety review was ruled out on 2026-10-09. That is reversed, because AC4's 'pending Operational Safety Check is closed' can only happen from Safety review (TC04). The lifecycle diagram (docs/ConnectSphere_Status_Lifecycle.drawio) gains Approved, Safety review and Safety approved -> Postponed. Not from Under review: nothing is arranged before approval, and the organiser can withdraw instead (TC09). Not from Draft or Submitted (no assigned Coordinator), Completed, Rejected, Withdrawn or Cancelled (final), nor from Postponed itself (TC10).

DECIDED 2026-10-26 (AC1, AC5 wording): the Overview header gets a 'Postpone event' button (secondary, before 'Cancel event') for the assigned Coordinator only. It opens a ConfirmDialog in the style of SPM-37's: title 'Postpone this event?', text '<event title> will be marked Postponed. Its new date is set later, through a change request.', then 'Postponing will:' with one line per consequence in this order: 'Release <venue (code)> on <date, times>' for each Approved booking; 'Withdraw the request for <venue (code)> on <date, times>' for each Pending request; 'Release <reserved> × <equipment>' for each Reserved or Partially fulfilled line; 'Cancel the request for <requested> × <equipment>' for each line not yet reserved; 'Close the pending postponement request' (or 'Close <n> pending postponement requests'); 'Close the pending safety check' or 'Close the safety approval'; 'Pause registration until the event is confirmed again: <n> registered, <n> on the waiting list' when registration is on. With none of these it reads 'This event has no venue bookings, equipment or registration to release.' Then 'Reason (optional)' (up to 2,000 characters) and the buttons 'Postpone event' and 'Keep event'.

DECIDED 2026-10-26 (AC1, AC5, after postponing): a green alert 'The event has been postponed. Its venue bookings and equipment have been released.' (shown even when there was nothing to release, TC08), the 'Postponed' badge, and on the Overview, for every role that can open the event, an amber alert titled 'This event is postponed' with the reason, or 'No reason was recorded.' when it was left empty. CHANGED 2026-10-27 (build, kayalvizhi24): no new column - the reason is kept in the status history row of the move to Postponed (the route already wrote it there), and GET /api/events/[id] adds it as postponementReason only while the event is Postponed, read from the latest such row. So no migration on the shared database, and a resumed event shows no alert (TC13).

DECIDED 2026-10-26 (AC3): postponing uses SPM-67's statuses as Cancel Event does - an Approved booking becomes 'released' and a Pending request 'withdrawn', with cancelledBy/cancelledAt set and cancellationReason 'Event postponed: <reason>', or 'Event postponed.' with no reason, shown on the Venue tab as 'Reason for release: …' / 'Reason for withdrawal: …'. Venue Staff get SPM-67's 'Venue booking released' notification for each released booking (TC02); a withdrawn request sends nothing. Every equipment line not already cancelled becomes 'cancelled', reserved or not, so Technical Support's queue holds nothing for an event with no date; the Coordinator asks for equipment again after it is rescheduled. All in one transaction with the status change. The event record, its details, sessions and status history are kept (AC3, 'the event record itself is retained').
